items.title: Trump gains a tariff weapon against China and India. Will he use it?
items.description: U.S. House has paved the way for a legislation that will allow Trump to impose up to 100% tariffs on countries buying Russian oil, giving him leverage against India and China.

items.title: Trump says U.S. ‘hopefully’ nearing end of Iran war as Saudi Arabia-Houthis trade strikes
items.description: Trump says the U.S. may be nearing the end of its nearly seven-month war with Iran, as he signals Tehran is open to a deal.

items.title: Reddit co-founder says tech industry has been 'tone deaf' in explaining AI: 'Misinformation flying around'
items.description: Alexis Ohanian said AI risks are more mundane than the "Terminator and Skynet" scenarios some fear.

items.title: 'Hostile act': Trump threatens EU with tariffs over Canada associate-membership proposal
items.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said EU is opening the door for Canada to become the first associate member of the 27-member bloc.

items.title: Bank of England set to defy Fed’s rate-hike lead, despite rising inflation
items.description: The Bank of England is expected to keep rates steady Thursday, even after U.K. inflation rose to 3.1% and energy costs keep pressure on prices.

items.title: Inside India newsletter: The world’s largest real-time payments system will no longer be free for all
items.description: India's digital payment system, which processes more than 1 million transactions every two minutes for free now, will start charging fees to merchants.

items.title: A stronger dollar and rising yields: How the Fed’s rate hike could hit global markets
items.description: Higher U.S. rates could also keep global bond yields elevated and weigh on equity valuations and economic growth.

items.title: Putin braces for election stress test as Russians ‘feel the pain’ of struggling economy
items.description: Russia’s upcoming election is expected to cement United Russia’s dominance, but voter turnout and its margin of victory could offer clues to public discontent.

items.title: Mark Walter and Todd Boehly selling stakes in Chelsea Football Club to Clearlake Capital
items.description: Two of Walter's insurance companies faces federal criminal and civil investigations into the accounting of roughly $21 billion in financial transactions.

items.title: Japan’s corporate leaders sound alarm over weak yen — even dollar-earners are voicing concerns
items.description: While the Japanese yen has strengthened rapidly over the past two weeks, it remains weak in historical terms.

items.title: Oil extends losses as Saudi Arabia reportedly offers ship-to-ship crude transfers after pipeline hit
items.description: Oil prices fell as additional Saudi crude supplies eased concerns over disruptions to the kingdom’s exports.

items.title: House advances bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
items.description: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.

items.title: Trump says he still has confidence in Fed Chair Warsh, demands 1% or lower interest rates
items.description: President Donald Trump previously threatened to cut off trade with countries that have trade surpluses with the U.S. if the Fed doesn't cut interest rates.

items.title: OpenAI reports 6 new instances of 'concerning model behavior' since March
items.description: OpenAI has disclosed six new cases of model misbehavior and offered a framework for disclosing future instances, as the debate over AI model safety intensifies.

items.title: House passes sweeping Russia sanctions bill honoring Lindsey Graham, sends to Trump
items.description: The Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions bill is on a path to become law after the House votes in favor.

items.title: Analysis: How Trump could reignite the Fed independence fight after Warsh's rate hike
items.description: The Federal Reserve unanimously raised interest rates by a quarter point despite repeated calls from President Donald Trump for lower rates.

items.title: Amazon obtains right to buy stock in Generac, boosting power company's share price by over 40%
items.description: Amazon was granted warrants to buy up to $340 million worth of Generac stock as part of a deal to supply backup power generators for its data centers.

items.title: House votes to hold Leon Black in contempt of Congress over Epstein subpoenas defiance
items.description: Billionaire Leon Black is suing the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform seeking to block subpoenas it issued him in its probe of Jeffrey Epstein.

items.title: Trump's Kennedy Center closure is 'unlawful,' Rep. Beatty tells judge in emergency hearing request
items.description: President Donald Trump says renovations at the Kennedy Center will not occur until the courts allow his name to be restored on the performing arts center.

items.title: 'Science fiction': Transport companies — the backbone of economy — are sounding alarm on fuel prices
items.description: Prices for diesel, the fuel type used to power trucks and trains, came in at an all-time high of $6.31 per gallon on Wednesday.
